segments.text:
V. 15.
Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with my own?—Yea, doubtleſs: To give either to Jew or Gentile, a Reward infinitely greater than he deſerves. But can it be inferred from hence, That it is lawful, or poſſible, for the merciful Father of Spirits, to
"Conſign an unborn Soul to Hell!
"Or damn him from his Mother's Womb?"
Is thine eye evil, becauſe I am good?—Art thou envious, becauſe I am gracious? Here is an evident Reference to that malignant Aſpect, which is generally the Attendant of a ſelfiſh can envious Temper.
